caption: The image is a pencil drawing on a light beige background depicting a quadruped animal with features resembling both a horse and a wolf, such as a long tail with jagged fur sections and pointed ears. The animal is shown in mid-stride, with its left foreleg and left hindleg extended forward, and its right hindleg extended backward, suggesting movement. There is a vertical pole intersecting the drawing, positioned just in front of the animal's left hindleg. The drawing is enclosed in a thin, rectangular border. In the lower left corner, there is a measured scale marked in inches from 0 to 6, and in the lower right corner, the text "SALVATORE BORRAZZO" appears. The image is rendered in grayscale, with varied shading to indicate the animal's musculature and contours.
title: Prairie Horse Weather Vane
